collection.name: Suwappu Positions
collection.tagline: Pick one of the 35 tokenized equities with a live Chainlink feed on Robinhood Chain. Your entry price is stamped on-chain forever.
collection.compliance: Collectible position card. It records a price observed on a DEX at mint time and displays a notional return against it. It is NOT equity, NOT a security, NOT a derivative or a claim of any kind, confers no shareholder or voting rights, pays nothing out, and gives no economic exposure to any issuer or to the referenced ERC-20.

economics._comment: Fee discount for holding any Position. Set against a FREE tier of 100 bps with a 10 bps floor. 40 bps = $4 saved per $1,000 swapped, so an active trader recoups a mint in ~$4k of volume. REVENUE TRADEOFF: this is deliberately material — a 5 bps token is not worth minting. Tune here, it is the single source for the perk.

mint._comment: Phase plan. Allocations sum to MAX_SUPPLY minus the 200-card team reserve. The allocation per phase is what prevents the classic failure of an allowlist bigger than the supply behind it — the phase cannot oversell, so latecomers get a clean revert instead of a gas war.

Founder.who: Earned: XP level gold/platinum, >= $50k lifetime volume, or >= 5 referrals
Founder.note: Free. These are the users who already built the product's volume.

Allowlist.who: Earned: >= 5 swaps, >= $1k lifetime volume, or >= 1 referral

mint._price_comment: USD CENTS, not ETH. SuwappuPositions prices in cents (uint96) and converts to wei at mint time through the ETH/USD Chainlink feed, so a card costs the same $20 whether ETH is at $2k or $4k. The previous price_eth fields were the wrong unit: fed to configurePhase() they would truncate to 0 cents, and 0 now reverts with PriceZero. A deliberately free phase (Founder) goes through configureFreePhase() instead.

brand._comment: Lifted from packages/design-tokens/src/tokens.ts -> designTokens.brand, which is now the single canonical source for every Suwappu surface (previously this read showcase/tailwind.config.ts, one of two live and disagreeing systems). tests/test_brand_tokens.py re-reads the package and fails if these drift.
